summary: Ocugen filed an 8-K on September 8, 2026, furnishing an investor presentation under Item 7.01 and disclosing clinical updates. The company announced first patient dosing in the global Phase 3 registrational trial of OCU410 (AAV5-hRORA) for Geographic Atrophy secondary to dry AMD, following a July 2026 Type B EOP2 meeting and RMAT designation. Separately, the independent Data Monitoring Committee for the OCU410ST Phase 2/3 trial recommended modifying and continuing the study after a pre-specified interim analysis of 26 subjects. No deal, securities, or special-situation terms; routine disclosure.
